preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in input_string for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output must exist in the input string.
Every character in the output must appear at least twice in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in return_value or input_string.count(c) >= 2 for c in input_string)
postconditions.description: If a character is not in the output, it must appear fewer than twice in the input string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for c in input_string if input_string.count(c) >= 2)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly the characters that appear at least twice in the input, preserving their order of first occurrence.
